video_title: The REAL problem with Jaylen Brown and should he just shut up and fall in line 👀

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley questions why the Celtics would trade Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: How are y'all talking about trading me because my value is high?

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown, Boston Celtics. They showed their hand. I said this before, the year they won it, he was the best player offensively and defensively. Now you're telling me we come back, we're cooking again, Jayson Tatum goes out, you have us one of the worst teams in the NBA with their second seed team. How are y'all talking about trading me because my value is high?

text_blocks.speaker: Cam'ron
text_blocks.text: He traded himself though, Pat. He made the statement. This was the best year.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley argues Jaylen Brown's 'best year' comment was calculated
quotes.excerpt: Everything that he's doing right now is very calculated. I guarantee you it's very calculated.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: As hoopers, I think we have to understand that we don't know how he really meant it. In his mind, it could have been like, it's one of my favorite years of everyone doubted us and we came out on top. Everything that he's doing right now is very calculated. I guarantee you it's very calculated.

text_blocks.speaker: Cam'ron
text_blocks.text: But he never came back and doubled down.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley believes Jaylen Brown wants his own team
quotes.excerpt: I think he wants out. I think he wants his own team.
quotes.quote: Everything that he's doing right now is very calculated. I guarantee you it's very calculated. I think he wants out. I think he wants his own team.

quotes.speaker: Allen Iverson
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Iverson discusses Jaylen Brown's controversial reputation with NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: He's very controversial. Anti-Nike, anti-this. You can fuck up the money.

text_blocks.speaker: Allen Iverson
text_blocks.text: I'm going to put my business hat on. He's very controversial. Anti-Nike, anti-this. You can fuck up the money. Jaylen Brown, you ain't going to get no headaches from Jaylen Brown. We know this league ain't about basketball sometimes. It's about the other shit.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: Who was that GM that said he was too smart for the league?

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley defends Jaylen Brown's off-court conduct
quotes.excerpt: What has he done wrong off the court, on the court, to validate any negative anything?
quotes.quote: What has he done wrong off the court, on the court, to validate any negative anything about Jaylen Brown? We see him traveling, we see him in healthy relationships, we see him working out, we see him healthy, we see him producing. We see him producing so much that he has to speak up for himself like, damn, why I'm not in the MVP racing?

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley suggests the best fit for Jaylen Brown is the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Get off the De'Aaron Fox contract, give him some picks, give him one of them young guys.
quotes.quote: Best fit for Jaylen Brown? I ain't going to lie, Spurs. Get off the De'Aaron Fox contract, give him some picks, give him one of them young guys, Jaylen Brown. It fits.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley argues the Celtics don't care about Jaylen Brown's desires
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the Celtics give a fuck about what Jaylen Brown wants.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: Ultimately, I don't think the Celtics give a fuck about what Jaylen Brown wants. They're going to get the return for what they're getting. Clearly, they don't care.

text_blocks.speaker: Cam'ron
text_blocks.text: His ass might end up in Charlotte then.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley advises against trading Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they should trade him. I ain't going to lie, don't trade him, man.
quotes.quote: I don't think they should trade him. I ain't going to lie, don't trade him, man.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley praises Jaylen Brown's professionalism
quotes.excerpt: He's never went at his teammates or the team. He's always went at the media.
quotes.quote: He's never went at his teammates or the team. He's always went at the media. He's always went about how things is unfair. In the media, he always went, he just never, we've never heard him talk anything bad about his teammates, not one time. So we can't even paint him to be just this cancer in the locker room, because that's not even the case.
